blocks.text: Bugun biz sizderdi academician K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityin ardaktuu okutuuchularyn biri - professor Ishemkulov Tilektesh Ishemkulovich menen taanyshtyrabyz
BMUnun to the professor - Tilektesh Ishemkulovich Ishemkulov
Kyrgyz Republic son madaniyatyna emgek sinirgen ishmer, Kyrgyz Republic son ozgocho zhana Yigarym ukuktuu Elchisi, BMUnun journalism zhana maalymat systemalary facultyin professor.
Anyn omur zholu - өlkөgө kyzmat kyluunun өrnөgү:
– Komsomolduk, partylyk zhana mamlekettik tүzүmdөrdө zhetekchilik kyzmattarda ishtegen
– Kyrgyz Republic son of Kazakstandagi birinchi Elchisi Bolgon
– “Sovettik Kyrgyzstan” gezitinin head to the editor
– alty kiteptin zhana 200dөn ashuun makalanyn, adabii-ilimiy izildөolөrdүn to the author
– BUU, UNESCO syyaktuu el aralik yumdardyn rasmiy documentterin kyrgyz tiline kotorgon

Bishkek mamlekettik universityinde journalism departmentsynyn negizdөөchүlөrүnүn biri bolup, bugunkү kүndөda okutuuchuluk, ilimiy zhana chygarmachylyk ishmerduүlүgүn ulantyp kelet. Өзүнүн bilimi, tazhryybasy zhana ruhaniy duynosumenen studentterge dem berip, alarms oh zhugүrtuүgө, zhazuuga zhana mekenge kyzmat kyluuga shyktandyryp kelet.
Zhakynda ele al studentterge ozuz zhazgan yrlaryn okup berip, oshol uchur tartylgan video internet koldonuuchularynyn zhurogunon orun alyp, keniri tarap ketti.
Agaidyn sabaktary - bul zhon gana bilim beru emes, rukhany baylykka zhol achkan taasirdu munottor!
